availability.panelIntro: A rule can be saved with any of these steps, and OpenLinker will accept it. Only the ones marked ready will actually do anything when the rule fires.
availability.panelTitle: What automations can do in this build
availability.ruleBlockedMany: These steps cannot run in this build: {actions}.

composer.a1Note: Which document gets issued, and by which provider, is decided by your Sales documents routing rules. This automation only decides when.
composer.a2NoOptions: Service level and package presets are not available yet, so the carrier default is used and the order’s own weight and size are declared.
composer.a2Warning: Every time this runs, it buys a label and you are charged for it.
composer.a3Note: OpenLinker relays what it knows. If no label has been bought yet, the marketplace is told the order shipped without a tracking number.
composer.activeHint: You can save it switched off and turn it on once you are happy with it.
composer.activeLabel: Turn this on when I save it
composer.carrierEmpty: No carrier is connected yet, so this step cannot be set up.
composer.carrierHint: Which carrier account to buy from.
composer.codLabel: Collect the order total from the buyer on delivery
composer.conditionsHint: Every condition must be true for the automation to run. Leave this empty to act on every one.
composer.currencyHint: Only orders in this exact currency can match. Nothing is converted.
composer.duplicateRule: You already have an automation that does exactly this over an overlapping period. Both would run, doubling whatever they do - change something about this one, or narrow when it applies.
composer.holdReasonHint: Why it is being held. The operator who finds it sees this.
composer.illegalPair: This event cannot do "{action}". Pick a different step, or a different event to watch for.
composer.mergeFieldsHint: Click one to insert it. Anything else is sent exactly as you type it - including a field name you mistype, so you can see and fix it.
composer.moneyAckLabel: I understand this automation spends money every time it runs, and those steps cannot be undone.
composer.nameHint: You will see this on the run log and on the order timeline.
composer.nonRetroactivity: An automation only acts on things that happen after you save it.
composer.noteRequiredHint: Required, the same as when you lift a hold by hand.
composer.readOnly: Your account can look at automations but not create them.
composer.stopOnFirstFailure: Steps run in order, and if one fails the rest are skipped. You can add up to {max}.

composerSchema.actionsRequired: Add at least one step - an automation with no steps does nothing.
composerSchema.addressRequired: Enter the address to send to.
composerSchema.carrierRequired: Pick the carrier account to buy from.
composerSchema.currencyShape: Enter a three-letter currency code, like PLN.
composerSchema.effectiveFromRequired: Pick the day this starts applying.
composerSchema.holdReasonRequired: Pick why the order is being held.
composerSchema.noteRequired: Say why the hold is being lifted.
composerSchema.triggerRequired: Pick the event to watch for.
composerSchema.valueRequired: Pick a value for this condition.

dryRun.factsTitle: What OpenLinker knew about this order
dryRun.failedHint: Nothing was evaluated, so this says nothing about whether the rule would match.
dryRun.gateLocked: Test this rule before saving it - it can spend money, and OpenLinker cannot undo that.
dryRun.gateStale: You changed the rule after testing it. Test it again so what you save is what you checked.
dryRun.intro: Pick an order from the last 30 days and see what this rule would have done. Nothing is sent, bought or changed.
dryRun.matchedButBlocked: It matched this order, but another rule already does something that cannot be done twice.
dryRun.noConditions: This rule has no conditions, so it applies to every one of these events.
dryRun.noOrders: No orders in the last 30 days, so there is nothing to test against yet.
dryRun.noOtherRules: No other rules watch this event.
dryRun.retroactivityWaived: It matches, but this order is older than the rule - so it would not actually have run. Only things that happen after you save it are acted on.
dryRun.staleResult: You changed the rule after this test, so the result below describes the previous version.
dryRun.title: Test on a recent order
dryRun.wouldMatchNotFire: This rule matches, but would not have run
dryRun.wouldNotFire: This rule would not have run

failureTitle.issue-sales-document: Couldn't issue the invoice for order {ref}

droppedRows.one: {n} event could not be read and is not shown below.
droppedRows.other: {n} events could not be read and are not shown below.

index.lastFiredUnknownHint: OpenLinker does not record what automations did yet, so this cannot say when one last acted. It is not a claim that nothing has.

tokens.buyerName: the buyer's name as the source reported it, or "customer" when it is not stored
tokens.holdReason: the current hold's reason, or "no hold"
tokens.orderDispatchBy: the marketplace dispatch deadline (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC), or "no deadline"
tokens.orderTotal: the gross total with its currency
tokens.shipmentTracking: the tracking number, or "not yet" ("not available" in a buyer email)

nonFiringReasons.condition-currency-mismatch: The amount is in a different currency from this order, and nothing is converted.
nonFiringReasons.condition-fact-unknown: A condition asked about something OpenLinker does not know for this order.
nonFiringReasons.condition-not-met: A condition was not true for this order.
nonFiringReasons.fact-precedes-rule: This happened before the rule was saved, and rules are never retroactive.
nonFiringReasons.fact-time-unknown: OpenLinker does not know when this happened, so it cannot tell whether the rule already existed.
nonFiringReasons.illegal-trigger-action-pair: This rule pairs an event with a step that event can never run.
nonFiringReasons.no-actions: The rule has no steps left that this version can run.
nonFiringReasons.no-longer-effective: The rule stopped applying before this order.
nonFiringReasons.not-yet-effective: The rule does not start applying until later.
nonFiringReasons.trigger-config-invalid: The rule is missing the setting its event needs.
nonFiringReasons.trigger-mismatch: This rule watches for a different event.
nonFiringReasons.unknown-trigger: This rule watches for an event this version does not recognise.

page.description: Rules that act on your orders and returns without you clicking. Each one watches for a single event, checks the conditions you set, and then does what you told it to.
page.tableCaption: Every event an automation can watch for
page.title: Automations

retryRefusal.not-failed: This run did not fail, so there is nothing to run again.
retryRefusal.retry-exhausted: This has been run again the maximum number of times without succeeding. Fix what is failing at the source, or dismiss it.
retryRefusal.rule-deleted: This automation has been deleted, so there is no longer anything to run. The record of what it did stays here.
retryRefusal.subject-unsupported: Running again is not possible for a return.
retryRefusal.superseded: This run has already been tried again. Open the newer attempt to see what happened.

rules.neverMatchedUnknown: OpenLinker cannot yet tell you whether this rule has ever matched an order.
rules.readOnly: Your account can look at automations but not change them.
rules.turnOffHint: Turning a rule off keeps everything it has already done.

inventory.reservation_shortfall.description: Stock was promised to orders that cannot all be filled.
inventory.reservation_shortfall.label: You have sold more than you have

order.dispatch_deadline_near.description: Checked on a timer, so it can warn you before you are late.
order.dispatch_deadline_near.label: A dispatch deadline is close

order.document_issued.description: Fires once, when the order's sales document is issued.
order.document_issued.label: An invoice or receipt is issued

order.hold.placed.description: Something stopped an order from being sent.
order.hold.placed.label: An order is put on hold

order.hold.released.description: Whatever was blocking the order has been cleared.
order.hold.released.label: An order comes off hold

order.on_hold_for.description: Checked on a timer, not the moment the order stops.
order.on_hold_for.label: An order has been stuck for too long

order.packed.description: Fires the moment someone at the packing bench marks it done.
order.packed.label: An order is marked packed

order.received.description: Fires once, the first time OpenLinker takes the order in.
order.received.label: A new order comes in

order.shipped.description: Fires once the order's parcels are with the carrier and the tracking number is known, or 30 minutes after the carrier takes the parcel if none arrives.
order.shipped.label: An order is shipped

return.disposed.description: Restocked, scrapped or sent on - whatever you decided.
return.disposed.label: A returned item is dealt with

return.received.description: Returned goods are received at your warehouse, once per parcel.
return.received.label: A return arrives
